players.product: large-megawatt diesel and gas backup generator sets (with in-house Enercon enclosures/packaging) for hyperscale and colocation data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 Commercial & Industrial segment total sales compare with $430.6 million in the prior-year quarter, with an approximate 6% net favorable impact to sales growth from acquisitions, divestitures and foreign currency; core growth was primarily driven by ramping revenue from products sold into the global data center market. C&I adjusted EBITDA was $81.5 million (14.6% of C&I total sales) versus $53.3 million (12.4%), with the margin increase primarily driven by an approximately 2% impact from tariff refunds. For the six months ended June 30, 2026, C&I total sales were $1,066,588 thousand versus $829,581 thousand.
